200.description: If operation is successful, duration will be in dataId field and success field is true. If it's failed, errorId has the error code(-1: duration is not available, -2: url is not opened, -3: cannot get stream info) and success field is false

message.description: The message of the operation result

dataId.description: The id of the record if operation is about adding a record

errorId.description: The id of error of the operation result
